verdict.rationale: Decagon documents brand-consistent channels (chat, voice, email all described as 'on-brand'), AOP-driven natural-language behavior definitions that function like brand/tone SOPs, and Duet-generated tests that explicitly verify agents 'reflect your brand.' Multilingual voice support is mentioned, but there's no concrete evidence of cross-topic/cross-language tone consistency validation or independent corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of tone consistency across topics and languages, detail on how brand voice guardrails are enforced across all channels simultaneously, and any third-party validation.
